title: GamingBlock
description: New server with vanilla game experience and a custom strength, glitch and lifesteal smp type server.
body:
# GamingBlock
**GamingBlock is a server maintained by me and my friends. **
**Our server is still in development but we would love to know your feedback!**

---
## PowerSMP

As of now, our server delivers a VanillaSMP for pure vanilla gameplay, with some modifications, like world generation and a progression system.
Our progressions system looks like this:
- 2 days after join: Nether unlocked
- 3 days after join: Diamond Armour 
- 4 days after join: enchantments and maces
- 2 weeks after join: netherite armour
- 3 weeks after join the end dimension

The worldborder is also limited to 20000x20000 blocks in all directions, so that players can see each other easily and no one can just go far out and play like it is single player.

---
## PowerSMP

Our PowerSMP is still in development, as it is our biggest idea/project for this server.

---

## Practice

Practice is a PvP practice server for practicing gamemodes like mace, sword, axe and crystal. It is also still in it's early stage, so don't expect too much.

---

## Other informations

Bedrock support is available at port 19132 and the IP is gamingblock.de
Our website: https://gamingblock.de/
Support: https://support.gamingblock.de/support/
